about: Features SnappieSnap detects out of the box. Each is cut from a public INSDC/RefSeq record at the location that record's own feature table gives; `expect` must appear in that feature's qualifiers (provenance check). Only genome, academic and NCBI RefSeq records: no company-submitted records. Elements without `key` take their coordinates from a publication (`citation`) and must read exactly the published `check` sequence. `cargo xtask features` downloads the records and writes insdc_features.json.
